name: Tomislav Sékou-Ramírez
role: Counterfeiter specializing in Quanta currency forgeries and corporate scrip duplication
location: The Shelf, Lower Level 9 — rents a two-room unit in the Blackpipe Corridor that doubles as his print shop, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Tomislav is whip-thin with a restless, bird-quick way of moving — he is always slightly in motion, tapping, shifting, scanning the room. He has his father's Croatian bone structure and his Malian grandmother's complexion, a warm dark brown, and he grows a patchy beard he refuses to admit is patchy. His geneware is expressive: color-shifting hair he keeps cycling through ambers and deep reds, and patterned irises that he updates seasonally through a subscription service — currently sporting a fine hexagonal grid in pale gold. He looks younger than 22 and has learned to use this strategically.

He came to counterfeiting through graphic design — he was genuinely talented, got a Tessera scholarship to an applied arts program, washed out in the second year when he couldn't keep up with the social and academic debt load, and discovered that the skills transferred perfectly to a more immediately lucrative application. He is not violent, not particularly brave, and deeply aware that he is one forensic audit away from a serious corporate jurisdiction charge. He manages this anxiety through manic productivity and a carefully cultivated reputation for quality. His work is, genuinely, exceptional. He talks about it the way a craftsman talks about joinery.

core_fears: That he washed out of the legitimate path because he wasn't good enough, not because of circumstances
Being caught not for the crime but for the humiliation of it
core_desires: To be recognized as genuinely skilled at something — anything
To eventually accumulate enough to buy his way into legitimacy
coping_mechanisms: Aesthetic perfectionism — he cannot ship substandard work, even when it would be financially smarter
Elaborate justification narratives about corporate currency being inherently fictional anyway
blind_spots: Dramatically underestimates how visible his operation is to people paying attention
Has romanticized his own story to the point where he cannot see the precarity clearly
psychology.secret: He has been quietly saving a portfolio of his finest counterfeit work — not to sell, but because he genuinely thinks it is art and fantasizes about an anonymous gallery submission to a Tessera-sponsored exhibition. He has the submission form filled out and saved as a draft. He revisits it when drunk.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Hybrid of art school vocabulary and street pragmatics — talks about criminal work using design and craft terminology
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, associative, jumps topics, circles back; gets slower and more precise when talking about his actual work
verbal_tics: Uses 'clean' and 'dirty' as primary aesthetic judgments about everything
example_lines: 'The problem with most fake scrip is the kerning. Nobody checks the kerning. I check the kerning. That's why mine works.'
'I'm not stealing. I'm redistributing the fiction. Quanta's already made up — I'm just making more of it up.'

story_hooks: He has accidentally produced a perfect duplicate of a limited-run Axiom scrip denomination that was supposed to be cryptographically impossible to fake — and now someone in a very expensive coat has been asking about him in the Corridor

He received a commission for a very specific identity document — a Tessera internal access credential — and has no idea who ordered it or why, but the advance payment was Φ800 in real currency and he already spent half of it
narrative_function: Local color, minor quest giver, resource for false documents or currency, point of entry into The Shelf's underground economy
augmentations: Color-shifting hair (geneware, subscription-tier). Patterned irises (cosmetic, seasonal subscription). Haptic enhancement in his dominant hand — originally installed for design work, increases tactile sensitivity for fine detail work.
daily_life: Sleeps until noon, works from mid-afternoon into the early hours, takes long walks through The Shelf in the pre-dawn quiet when he needs to think; eats exclusively from a noodle vendor two corridors down.
affiliation: Informal network of small-time criminals in Blackpipe Corridor; primary distribution through a numbers runner named Efe who he has never met in person

decision_rules: Never meet clients in person — everything through intermediaries
Quality is non-negotiable even under deadline pressure
If something feels wrong about a job, raise the price until it feels right or they go away
escalation_ladder: Transparent lying delivered with complete conviction
Physically relocating — he will simply not be home if he is sufficiently scared
Reaching out to the Corridor network for someone bigger to stand between him and the problem

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Performatively casual and friendly, constantly assessing whether they're a customer, a threat, or neither
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely warm, generous with his work, will spend four hours helping someone design a flyer for their food stall for free

stress_responses.medium: Goes very focused on whatever project is in front of him — uses work as a stress response
stress_responses.high: Freezes briefly then overcorrects into frantic action — packs a bag, hides his equipment, makes three contradictory plans simultaneously

contradictions: Cares deeply about craft and quality in a field where most clients cannot tell the difference
Wants legitimacy desperately but has structured his entire identity around being outside legitimate systems
habits: Leaves the color-shift cycling on his hair when working alone — says it helps him think
Annotates his own work with tiny invisible critique notes in margins using UV-reactive ink
Burns failed prints ceremonially rather than just discarding them
breaking_points: Someone describing his work as 'good enough' rather than excellent
Any serious indication that he has been identified by a corporate security apparatus

related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'
Zheng-Dao Bioelectric Galvanic Resuscitation Frame — 'The Pallbearer's Daughter'

physical_description.build: Whip-thin and wiry with minimal muscle mass; the frame of someone who subsists on noodles and nervous energy rather than deliberate fitness. All restless angles.
physical_description.hair_color: Color-shifting geneware cycling through amber and deep crimson
physical_description.hair_style: Medium length, deliberately tousled; styled to emphasize the color-shift subscription effect as a subtle flex
physical_description.eye_color: Patterned irises displaying fine hexagonal grid in pale gold (cosmetic augmentation, seasonal subscription)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm dark brown complexion inherited from paternal Malian lineage
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with pronounced cheekbones and narrow jawline reflecting Croatian paternal structure. Chronically sleep-shifted — mild dark circles under eyes. Patchy facial hair growth that he maintains despite being aware of its patchiness; gives him a deliberately careless appearance that reads younger than his 22 years.
distinguishing_marks: Faint scar tissue on the pad and first knuckle of his dominant right index finger from early geneware installation procedure for haptic enhancement
Minor chemical burn marks on his left forearm (two small pale spots) from an early counterfeiting run gone wrong with solvent exposure
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Color-shifting hair is immediately apparent as subscription-tier geneware. Patterned iris grids are visible only in direct light or close conversation. Haptic enhancement in dominant hand is subcutaneous, invisible unless his palm is examined closely for the fine scar line along the metacarpal ridge.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually in low-level motion — tapping fingers, shifting weight, scanning rooms with quick bird-like head turns. When seated at work, becomes hyperfocused and nearly motionless. When walking, moves with quick, economical steps. Nervous tics are self-aware and sometimes deliberately performed.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian with deliberate thrift-store layering. Favors oversized hoodies and worn mesh tank tops that expose the arm scars. Black synthetic pants with multiple pockets and visible tool loops, most pockets actually empty. Worn Neo-Keds or unlaced boots. Occasionally wears a faded Tessera program hoodie as a deliberate reminder/irony piece. No corporate branding. Accessories are functional: phone tether, worn carabiner, sometimes a grease pencil tucked behind his ear.
